declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration in support of preliminary approval. After the complaint survived a motion to dismiss, counsel negotiated a settlement providing a $36 million class fund for approximately 400,000 identified members, with automatic payments and no claims process. The parties exchanged proposals over four rounds. Class relief and attorneys’ fees were discussed together from the first round; the class fund rose from Brightline’s initial $27 million proposal to $36 million, while the proposed cap on separately paid, court-approved fees and expenses fell from $5 million to $4 million. Brightline did not agree to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees the court declines to award will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. Class certification remains undecided, and trial is approximately two to three years away. Counsel assesses the chance of prevailing at trial at roughly 55%, with a likely award of approximately $50 million if the class prevails, subject also to certification risk. In my assessment, the certain $36 million fund and automatic distribution make the proposed settlement fair, reasonable, and adequate for purposes of preliminary approval, subject to the court’s review and notice to the class.
